title: VisAlloc: Allocating Visual Supervision for On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.25069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) offers a promising approach to improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models (MLLMs). However, not all samples benefit equally from privileged visual guidance, and uniform token supervision can dilute visually grounded signals. We propose VisAlloc, a dual-level framework combining sample-level visual filtering with token-level counterfactual reweighting. A fixed paired-teacher filter retains samples answered correctly from an evidence-centered positive crop but incorrectly from a spatially displaced negative crop. At the token level, both EMA teachers score the same student-generated response, and their absolute log-probability differences measure view sensitivity. Additional supervision targets tokens admitted by sensitivity or teacher-distribution disagreement, with shared frozen-prior, template-bigram, and student--teacher divergence gates. translated_title: VisAlloc：为在线策略自蒸馏分配视觉监督
translated_abstract: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）为提升多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的视觉推理能力提供了一种有前景的方法。然而，并非所有样本都能从特权视觉引导中平等受益，且统一的词元监督可能会稀释基于视觉的信号。我们提出VisAlloc，一个将样本级视觉过滤与词元级反事实重加权相结合的双层框架。一个固定的成对教师过滤器保留那些在以证据为中心的正向裁剪图像上回答正确、但在空间偏移的负向裁剪图像上回答错误的样本。在词元层面，两个EMA教师对同一学生生成的响应进行打分，其绝对对数概率差异用于衡量视角敏感性。额外的监督针对通过敏感性或教师分布分歧准入的词元，并采用共享的冻结先验、模板二元组以及师生分歧门控。逆频率重分配保留……
tldr: VisAlloc提出一种双层框架，通过样本级的正负裁剪成对教师过滤与词元级的EMA教师视角敏感性反事实重加权，将视觉监督精准分配到最需要的样本和词元上，从而提升多模态大语言模型的视觉推理能力。
en_tdlr: VisAlloc is a dual-level framework that combines sample-level paired-teacher visual filtering with token-level counterfactual reweighting based on view sensitivity, precisely allocating visual supervision to the samples and tokens that benefit most, thereby improving visual reasoning in multimodal large language models.
